column1: # Swedish names for the topics of the period models (models/period_lda_8), used by
# modeling/17_generate_period_explorer.py. Names are an interpretation of the top words and the
# top motions of each period's topic. "Blandat" marks broad topics without one clear theme.
# Format: period, topic number, its three most probable words, name (tab-separated). The
# generator shows a name only if the three words still match the model, so a refitted model
# with other topics gets no wrong names.
